Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps from today's discovery — evidence & stakeholders

Hi Sana / Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so procurement and security have a clear path: 

- Economic buyer / decision timeline: Sana indicated evaluation committee will convene the week of 5/20; primary economic buyer is CFO (Rahul Mehta) — procurement will need pricing + any reserved capacity options.
- Security asks we committed to deliver: SOC 2 attestation summary, pen-test report (redacted), audit-log retention policy, and data retention & deletion FAQ.
- Procurement path: procurement@clearhealth.com is the routing address; Tom will loop legal for contract playbook.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Michael: deliver SOC 2 summary, annotated checklist by EOD 5/10 (attached).
2) Marissa: prepare a short one-pager on Dedicated vs Hosted cost/latency tradeoffs for the CFO by 5/14.
3) Sana/Tom: confirm procurement/legal contacts and any required vendor forms (W-9, security questionnaire) — please send details by 5/11.
4) Joint: schedule a 30-min follow-up on 5/16 for readiness review (we suggested 10:00 PDT).

Attachments: SOC2-Checklist-annotated.xlsx (initial pass) — this is an internal annotated checklist mapping ClearHealth asks to the evidence we can provide.

If anything above is off, flag and I'll update. Thanks again — looking forward to moving to a short pilot.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Michael — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed economic buyer: Rahul Mehta (CFO). He asks for a clear monthly vs committed comparison and an example invoice.
- Security/legal: please send SOC 2 summary and pen-test redaction by EOD Monday (5/13) if possible. Our security team will review and may come back with two follow-up items.
- Procurement path: procure@clearhealth.com is right; legal contact is legal-review@clearhealth.com (will be cc'd on formal vendor docs).
- Pen test timing: our security team did an internal pen-test last quarter; we'd like to see Redwood's external pen-test report or a third-party attestation. Is that available?

I added Tom so he can share any procurement-specific templates. Also, 5/16 at 10:00 PDT works for a 30-min checkpoint.

On pen tests: if you only have in-house testing, mark that and provide scope — we can evaluate. Third-party reports are preferred for our audit team.

Sana
Director of IT Risk, ClearHealth

Looping in a quick cost vs performance note and delivery plan from the product/evals side.

1) Evidence delivery plan (what we'll provide this week):
   - SOC 2 attestation summary (PDF) — Michael attaching by 5/13.
   - Pen-test: if Redwood's latest third-party pen-test (Q4 2028) is acceptable we will share a redacted copy; if ClearHealth needs additional scoping, we can discuss a limited NDA to share full notes.
   - Audit logs: we provide 90-day default retention; retention options up to 7 years for Dedicated customers — see attached Data Retention FAQ draft.

2) Owners: Marissa will own Dedicated vs Hosted one-pager; Jonas will support with SLA language and audit-log export examples.

3) Decision criteria checklist (for Rahul/CFO and Security):
   - Cost predictability for 12-month commit
   - Evidence (SOC2 + pen-test attestation)
   - Data residency / VPC options
   - Integration effort (auth, SSO, audit logs)

Next steps: Michael to push the annotated SOC2 and Draft Data Retention FAQ to the Drive folder and confirm 5/16 meeting invite.

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery — evidence & stakeholders

Sana / team — quick note from the legal/ops angle before the follow-up meeting: 

- Audit logs and retention: attached I included examples of the export (CSV + structured event JSON) and a simple SLA excerpt that describes export timelines and formats. For Dedicated we can add weekly exports to an S3 bucket under your account; for Hosted we support on-request exports with 48–72 hour turnaround.
- Pen-test attestation: we have a third-party report from Q4 2028. I'll redact IP-specific exploits and share an excerpt in a secure link. If ClearHealth needs full findings for an internal audit we'll execute an NDA + controlled review.
- Procurement paperwork: Michael — please prepare a single ZIP with W-9, standard PO terms, and a sample SOW. Label it "ClearHealth-Procurement-ZIP.zip" and upload to the Drive folder so their procurement team has everything in one place.

I'm attaching the SOC2 summary and the sample audit-log export. If procurement/legal want a tailored SLT (service-level terms) we can iterate after Rahul's team reviews.

Jonas
Head of Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference
